offset: (variable.u.x * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) + variable.v.x * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1))) * (variable.r - variable.thick * variable.particle_random_2 * math.sin(variable.particle_random_1 * 180))

(variable.u.y * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) + variable.v.y * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1))) * (variable.r - variable.thick * variable.particle_random_2 * math.sin(variable.particle_random_1 * 180))

(variable.u.z * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) + variable.v.z * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1))) * (variable.r - variable.thick * variable.particle_random_2 * math.sin(variable.particle_random_1 * 180))
direction: (variable.u.x * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) + variable.v.x * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)))
(variable.u.y * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) + variable.v.y * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)))
(variable.u.z * math.cos((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)) + variable.v.z * math.sin((variable.a0 + (variable.a1 - variable.a0) * variable.particle_random_1)))

size: variable.particle_age < (variable.particle_random_1 * variable.dur) ? 0 : variable.size * (0.12 + math.sin(variable.particle_random_1 * 180) * 0.1) * (1 - math.clamp((variable.particle_age - (variable.particle_random_1 * variable.dur)) / variable.life, 0, 1) * 0.85)
